clue.text: Two fruit, from the sound of it

indicators.note: this phrase says the word for the fruit is only to be heard, and the entry is a word spoken the same way

parts.note: a pear is a fruit

explanation.surface: Someone says there are two pieces of fruit, judging only by what they hear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Two fruit' looks like a description of a pear pair; in fact 'Two' alone is the definition and 'fruit' is the PEAR heard aloud.
explanation.definitionFit: A couple of things make a set of two.

clue.text: Almost dark -almost

indicators.note: almost tells us the word for dark falls just short, losing its final letter

parts.note: night means darkness, the dark

explanation.surface: A stammering description of something that is very nearly dark.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Almost' at the start trims the last letter T from NIGHT (dark); the closing 'almost' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Near, close to: nigh is an old word for nearly.

clue.text: Indian city gunmen after silver

indicators.note: after places the gunmen's letters behind the silver's in the answer

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
RA is the Royal Artillery, the British army's gunners

explanation.surface: Armed men in an Indian city are hunting for silver.
explanation.definitionFit: Agra is the city in Uttar Pradesh that is home to the Taj Mahal.

clue.text: Quietly continue to speculate

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for playing quietly
to resume is to carry on after a pause

explanation.surface: Advice to go on guessing, but in a hushed voice.
explanation.definitionFit: To speculate is to suppose or assume without proof.

clue.text: Check cheats in tart fashion

parts.note: cons are swindles, ways to cheat someone

indicators.note: fashion as a verb means shape or rework, so the letters of the words in tart are made into something new

explanation.surface: A rebuke for swindlers who behave in a sharp, acidic way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in tart fashion' reads as an adverb phrase; 'fashion' rearranges IN TART into TRAINT after CONS.
explanation.definitionFit: A check is a restraint or limitation on action.

clue.text: A person who won't work well enough

definitions.text: A person who won't work well enough

parts.words: A person who won't work well enough
parts.note: read as someone who does poor work, but meaning someone who is perfectly well enough yet refuses to work, pretending illness

explanation.definitionFit: A shirker who feigns sickness to avoid duty, though fit to work.

clue.text: Family of crooked Orientals

indicators.note: crooked means bent out of shape, so the letters of Orientals are twisted into a new order

explanation.surface: A clan of dishonest people from the East.
explanation.definitionFit: One's family are one's kin or relatives.

clue.text: New lido, the object of much admiration

indicators.note: new signals that the word lido is made over into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A newly opened open-air swimming pool becomes a much-admired attraction.
explanation.walkthrough: A LIDO is a public open-air swimming pool in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone or something greatly revered or worshipped.

clue.text: Under a new title, it's falsely assumed

definitions.text: Under a new title, it's falsely assumed

parts.words: Under a new title, it's falsely assumed
parts.note: reads like something wrongly supposed about a renamed thing, but describes going about under an assumed false name to hide one's identity

explanation.definitionFit: Travelling in disguise, concealing one's real identity behind a false name.

clue.text: Pays attention in actual practice

indicators.note: in tells us one word is placed inside the other

parts.note: real means actual, genuine
someone who hears is paying attention, listening

explanation.surface: Someone listens closely during a real practice session.
explanation.definitionFit: A practice run or trial performance before the real event.

clue.text: Watch anyway

indicators.note: read as any way, it says the word is the same whichever way it is read, forwards or backwards

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.definitionFit: To keep an eye on is to observe or look at.

clue.text: Firm way to bring a charge

parts.note: Co is short for company, a firm
St is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: A business's method for billing its customers.
explanation.definitionFit: A cost is a price or fee demanded.

clue.text: Article on travel in years gone by

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
to go is to travel

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece about travel from the old days.
explanation.definitionFit: Earlier, in the past, back then.

clue.text: No longer allowed

parts.note: reads as something that has been banned, but describes a cap beyond which no more minutes may be taken

explanation.definitionFit: A deadline is the point after which no extra time is permitted.

clue.text: The steps they take are always sound

definitions.text: The steps they take are always sound

parts.words: The steps they take are always sound
parts.note: reads as praise for sensible actions, but describes dancers whose footwork always makes a noise, with metal plates on their shoes

explanation.definitionFit: Performers whose metal-tipped shoes click out rhythms on the floor.

clue.text: American colonial militia — little guys

definitions.meaning: the armed colonists of the American Revolution who were ready to fight at a moment's notice
read as ..., men who are tiny

explanation.definitionFit: The Revolutionary War militia were ready in a minute; split differently, it means tiny fellows.

clue.text: Stay in bed and scoff about splitting tip

indicators.note: splitting means the word for tip is broken apart with other letters set in the gap

parts.note: to list is to tilt or tip over to one side, like a ship
to scoff food is to eat it greedily
re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: Advice to stay in bed and sneer at a suggestion that has come in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scoff' means mock in the surface but eat here; 'splitting' puts EATRE inside LIST.
explanation.definitionFit: To lie quietly, resting without getting up.

clue.text: Some beggar begging from habit

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A beggar pleads out of long-standing habit.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'from habit' as the definition, but 'from' cannot replace the answer; it is a link word, and 'habit', in its sense of clothing like a monk's habit, is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A habit is a form of dress, as worn by monks or nuns.

clue.text: Rushed around a woman and so got across

indicators.note: around tells us the word for rushed surrounds the woman's name

parts.note: sped means hurried, rushed
Ann is a woman's name

explanation.surface: Someone hurried round a woman to get to the other side.
explanation.definitionFit: To span something is to extend over or across it.

clue.text: Putting little into a carrier is only human!

indicators.note: into says the word for little goes inside the word for the carrier

parts.note: a hod is a builder's trough for carrying bricks
mini means small, little

explanation.surface: Squeezing a tiny thing into a bag is excusable, after all we are only human.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of the family that includes humans and great apes, so roughly a person.

clue.text: Snarled when old Chinese went first

parts.note: Tang was a dynasty that ruled China long ago
led means went in front, went first

explanation.surface: Someone growled when an elderly Chinese man pushed in front.
explanation.definitionFit: A snarled rope or thread is knotted and twisted.

clue.text: Go on a strict diet without wavering

annotationWithheld.why: Clue 'Go on a strict diet without wavering (4)' is a plain double definition of FAST (go on a strict diet; steadfast, without wavering), but the answer is held as PAST; no parse gives PAST.
annotationWithheld.clue: Go on a strict diet without wavering

clue.text: Trains to charm

definitions.meaning: trains, like buses and ships, are means of conveyance
to charm is to enrapture or carry away with delight

explanation.definitionFit: Railways are a form of conveyance; and to enrapture someone is to carry them away with delight.

clue.text: Not French for a dance-movement

explanation.definitionFit: The French negative particle; and a ballet step.

clue.text: Do wrong with some hesitation, right?

parts.note: er is the sound of someone hesitating

explanation.surface: Someone hesitantly asks if a mistake is the correct thing.
explanation.definitionFit: To make a mistake or go astray.

clue.text: Superficial matter all about a note

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for all goes round the note

parts.note: the sum is the whole amount, all of it
C is a musical note

explanation.surface: Something shallow and trivial, all concerning a single memo.
explanation.definitionFit: The film of dirt that floats on the surface of a liquid.

clue.text: A certain group might see nothing a miss

indicators.note: read as amiss, wrong or out of place, so the letters are put in disorder

parts.note: O looks like a zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Some group might fail to notice anything wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a miss' reads as amiss: it rearranges MIGHT SEE plus O. An EIGHTSOME is a Scottish reel for eight dancers.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of a fixed number, eight people.

clue.text: Amphibian that appears to puff

parts.note: a puff is a piece of promotional praise, an advertisement

explanation.surface: An amphibian that looks as though it is inflating itself.
explanation.definitionFit: A warty frog-like creature that lives on land and water.

clue.text: Grants for snow disposal

indicators.note: disposal means arranging or setting out, so the letters of snow are laid out afresh

explanation.surface: Funding for clearing snow.
explanation.definitionFit: To own something is to admit or concede it.

clue.text: Egghead social worker climbing a mountain

parts.note: the head of egg, its first letter

indicators.note: climbing in a down clue means the word is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: an ant is a social insect and a worker

explanation.surface: An intellectual social worker going up a mountain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Egghead' looks like an intellectual but gives only E, the head of 'egg'.
explanation.definitionFit: Etna is a volcano in Sicily.

clue.text: Letters for the queen in the country

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, are the letters for the Queen

explanation.surface: Royal mail delivered to the countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: Erin is a poetic name for Ireland.

clue.text: Cutting into the pate

parts.note: reads like slicing a meat paste, but describes boring a hole in the skull

explanation.definitionFit: A surgical procedure that bores through the skull.
